blocks.html: Cebu City, Philippines, 23 April 2025 --- The NUSTAR Resort & Casino announces the opening of NUSTAR Hotel on 08 May 2025, ushering a new era of luxury hospitality in Cebu.

The highly anticipated debut of the 223-room NUSTAR Hotel marks an important milestone for NUSTAR and embodies the hotel’s brand ethos, a characteristic blend of refined luxury, worldclass accommodations and authentic heartfelt service.

The ultra-luxury hotel is the second of 3 hotels to open at the NUSTAR Resort & Casino complex. Since the launch of the integrated resort in May 2022, it has become an icon among the most recognizable skylines in Cebu.

HKS Singapore, the concept architects behind NUSTAR, designed the resort to dominate the SRP waterfront: The Fili Hotel and NUSTAR Hotel towers rise above the integrated casino and luxury mall complex, sprawling over 22-acres of stunning ocean frontage.
Located along the south coastal road of Cebu City, NUSTAR Hotel is approximately 30-minutes from the Mactan-Cebu International Airport and 15 minutes to the city’s historic and commercial districts.
THE NUSTAR BUTLER
Stays at NUSTAR include the services of dedicated butlers specially trained by Heilbron Hospitality, one of the world’s most respected training institutions for hospitality service.

Guests will appreciate the intuitive service and seamless arrangements -- from dining reservations, valet and transport services to tailored itineraries -- every detail is thoughtfully arranged, allowing guests more time to play, dine, relax and revitalize.
ROOMS & SUITES
Viewpoints were a key design driver for the project. The hotel towers were positioned to take full advantage of spectacular sea and Cebu skyline views.

Guest rooms are generous in size and the largest in the city. Signature rooms start from 52 square meters while suites range between 77 and 225 square meters, all with full-length windows offering sweeping vistas of the sea or city.
Luminous marble bathrooms are bathed in natural light and feature a deep soaking tub, Guerlain hair and skin care products and leading-edge intelligent facilities.

Bedrooms offer a calm sanctuary, with a soft palette of honey-toned wood offset by light earth colours and deep maroon accents. These complement the expansive views of azure seas and sunset hues of the island.
CLUB LOUNGE PRIVILEGES

Resident guests are welcome to enjoy a private breakfast, afternoon tea and early evening cocktails at the exclusive Fili Executive Club lounge, with compliments from NUSTAR Hotel. The Club Lounge is located on Level 23 of the Fili hotel.
THE NUSTAR VILLAS

Three luxury villas offer unparalleled comfort, modern aesthetics and timeless elegance. Ranging from 435 to 670 square meters, each villa features expansive interiors, a private sea-facing pool and a garden balcony, all designed with meticulous attention to detail.
ART, CULTURE AND DESIGN

The NUSTAR Hotel pays homage to Cebu’s rich maritime history as an international trading port in Asia. The concept design of HKS Singapore references naval wayfinding, by serving as a landmark on the horizon.

The 26-storey hotel tower is crowned by a glass-floored cantilevered viewing deck designed with principles of feng shui. Set to open later this year, the open-air Skydeck with far-reaching unobstructed views of the sea and city will become a must-visit tour destination.

Top designers from Hirsch Bedner Hong Kong created the hotel’s interiors with a central vision of timeless elegance and bold modernity, drawing inspiration from the architectural style of Compania Maritima, a neoclassical heritage building at the South Cebu port area.

The entrance opens to grand hallway with crystal chandeliers and leads to an expansive lounge with tall colonial columns and arches, cream-toned marble floors, antique-finish bronze mirrors and 5-meter-high windows with sweeping ocean views.

The bold interjection comes from Coral Reverie -- a dynamic installation featuring a burst of handblown glass corals in vivid ruby tones -- created by international Czech artist Petra Sošťáková. The luminous rare blue onyx wall and lace-inspired columns of light from custom-made Ferruccio Laviani lamps add modern glamour. Artful and inspiring, the lounge easily becomes Cebu’s see-and-be-seen meeting point for business & leisure.

“It is with great pride that we unveil NUSTAR Hotel to usher a new standard of luxury hospitality in Cebu,” said Mr. Sean Knights, Chief Operating Officer of NUSTAR Resort and Casino. “We aim to deliver a distinctive guest experience that brings the NUSTAR brand to life, blending worldclass gaming with premium accommodation, creative dining concepts and the renowned Cebuano flair for being natural hosts.”
OPENING OFFER

To celebrate the opening, NUSTAR Hotel offers up to 25% savings on room rates from 08 May to 31 July. After-discount rates from PHP 12,750++ per night and comes with full benefits as butler service, breakfast and club lounge privileges throughout the stay. For reservations and key information, guest may visit the hotel’s new website https://nustar.ph/hotels/, send an email to contactus@nustar.com.ph or call +63 32 888 8282.
About NUSTAR Hotel Cebu

NUSTAR Hotel is the first and only ultra-luxury hotel in Cebu City and southern Philippines. The hotel has 223 spacious guestrooms and suites that blend modern sophistication with timeless elegance, offering breathtaking views of Cebu's skyline, mountains, and seascape. The NUSTAR Hotel defines opulence with bespoke butler services, a tranquil spa, state-of-the-art fitness facility, and serene swimming pools. More than a place to stay, the NUSTAR Hotel is a statement on classic grandeur and bold modernity, setting a new benchmark for luxury hospitality in the region.
